reason: I don't need paint protection film this month, and I don't hand money to an app I've never heard of before asking my family in WhatsApp. Verified partners and money held until the work is done help, but I still want a name I know before I pay.
objection: How do I know the film is genuine and the warranty will be honoured when something goes wrong, especially with a partner I have never met?
would_change_my_mind: A friend or family member I trust tells me they used ArmorHub and the installer did good work and honoured the warranty.
